srList.sentence: Brain heart infusion media (BHI from Sigma Aldrich) supplemented with streptomycin, penicillin, and hemin (all from Sigma Aldrich) was used for L. tarentolae culturing following the method of Morgenthaler et al. 18.

srList.sentence: From a homogeneous suspension, L. tarentolae (100 mL) were loaded, in quadruplicate, into Falcon(r) 96 well plates following incubation with the MTT reagent (5 mgmL water), A 595 nm values were determined using the Bio-Rad iMark Microplate Reader plate reader.
